dashboard:
{@body const [period,setPeriod] = DIL.useState("本周")}
<card>
  <title>订单分布</title>
  <segmented-control label="订单周期" value={period} onChange={setPeriod}>
    <segment value="本周">本周</segment><segment value="上周">上周</segment>
  </segmented-control>
  <Chart content={{chartType:"scatter",xKey:"amount",labelKey:"label",filterKey:"period",filterValue:period,
    data:[{label:"甲",amount:1,orders:4,returns:1,period:"本周"},{label:"乙",amount:8,orders:9,returns:2,period:"本周"},{label:"丙",amount:6,orders:3,returns:1,period:"上周"}],
    series:[{dataKey:"orders",label:"订单"},{dataKey:"returns",label:"退货"}],meta:{title:"金额与成交"}}}/>
  <popover title="查看说明"><text>金额以百元计。</text></popover>
</card>
